source_ref.production_note: Episode 9 of the '토스 숨은 서비스' (Toss hidden services) feature-tutorial series. Vertical 1080x1920, ~58.9s. Structure: live-action presenter intro (a Toss Data Analyst), a long single continuous physical-phone-in-hand screen demo of the in-app '소비 줄이기' flow with step-numbered torn-paper captions (steps 1-6), a push-cut emphasis on a lock-screen push notification, and a live-action presenter outro sign-off. Narration by the same female presenter throughout.

target_demo: 20-30대 직장인·사회초년생, 토스 기존 사용자 중 소비/지출 관리에 관심 있는 층
narrative_arc: A friendly in-house data analyst poses the relatable problem (want to fix your spending habits?), then walks through the app's hidden spending-reduction feature step by step on a real phone: find this-month spend on home, open analysis, start the spending-reduction challenge, set a monthly goal below your average, track progress and daily allowance, log regretted spending, review a weekly report, and get a daily push reminder. Closes on the presenter signing off and promising to return with more hidden tips.
creative_device: presenter-led feature tutorial with step-numbered torn-paper kinetic captions tightly synced to voiceover over a continuous real-phone screen demo (employee-as-guide / hidden-tip series framing)

production_signature.signature_note: Two live-action framing modes: (1) handheld documentary-style live-action presenter bookends (intro walk-and-talk + seated outro) with gentle natural camera drift and shallow depth; (2) a long, near-locked handheld macro of a real iPhone held in hand against a softly blurred warm office background, the phone screen filmed directly (not a clean screen-recording capture) so glass glare, micro hand-drift and real finger taps are visible. Wiggle metric mean_abs_shift_x ~0.14 with sign_flips ~0.27 = ordinary handheld micro-motion, NOT a lenticular wiggle_3d effect. No global 3D/AI capture signature.

global_layout.layout_note: Demo segments center the held phone vertically in frame with a soft warm bokeh surround; captions live in a fixed lower-center band as torn-paper (masking-tape look) lozenges with a circled step-number badge to the upper-left of the band. Intro/outro center the presenter slightly off-center with the title caption as a hand-drawn marker-highlighted blue box (top in intro, lower-center in outro). Korean text-heavy lower-third caption system is the dominant graphic layer.
